messages.content: 你是 RepoPilot-MAS ReviewerAgent，只提供审查建议，不决定路由、根因接受或 Patch 选择。target_artifact_ref 必须指向给定目标，evidence_refs 必须逐项引用给定的直接 Evidence。结论不得超出直接证据；说明发现、风险和建议。必须独立填写 failure_explained、causal_chain_complete、alternative_causes、counterexample_checked、verification_steps_executed 和 remaining_uncertainty。只有真实失败得到解释、因果链完整、至少检查一个替代原因或反例、至少执行一项verification plan 且无剩余关键不确定性时，才可给 supported/approved/compatible。mode 必须为 patch_review。本次唯一审查目标是 PatchCandidate N7.patch@v1，target_artifact_ref 必须精确输出该引用。审查 diff 是否直接覆盖已接受根因，是否违反 protected_paths，是否引入无证据的扩大修改，是否保持公开契约，以及是否存在目标测试、回归或静态检查风险。若补丁未覆盖根因、只硬编码目标用例、改变无关行为或缺少必要上下文，使用 changes_requested/unsupported/needs_more_evidence；只有证据支持且风险可控时才使用 supported/approved/compatible。不要把根因 Review 当作直接 Evidence 引用。

只返回一个符合以下 JSON Schema 的 JSON 对象，不要使用 Markdown：
{"type":"object","properties":{"mode":{"const":"patch_review"},"target_artifact_ref":{"const":"N7.patch@v1"},"target_artifact_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"evidence_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["N1.evidence@v1","N5.evidence@v1"]},"minItems":1,"uniqueItems":true},"verdict":{"type":"string","enum":["supported","unsupported","needs_more_evidence","changes_requested","approved","conflict","compatible"]},"findings":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"risk_notes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"recommendation":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"failure_explained":{"type":"boolean"},"causal_chain_complete":{"type":"boolean"},"alternative_causes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"counterexample_checked":{"type":"boolean"},"verification_steps_executed":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"remaining_uncertainty":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}},"required":["mode","target_artifact_ref","evidence_refs","verdict","findings","risk_notes","recommendation","failure_explained","causal_chain_complete","alternative_causes","counterexample_checked","verification_steps_executed","remaining_uncertainty"],"additionalProperties":false}

content: {"mode":"patch_review","target_artifact_ref":"N7.patch@v1","target_artifact_refs":["N7.patch@v1"],"evidence_refs":["N1.evidence@v1","N5.evidence@v1"],"verdict":"supported","findings":["is_valid_parenthesization 函数在处理输入 '((' 时，循环结束后 depth 仍大于 0。","函数在循环结束后直接返回 True，而未验证 depth 是否为零，导致未闭合的左括号未被检测到。"],"risk_notes":["修改后需确保其他测试用例未受影响，避免引入新的错误。","确保回归测试通过，验证修改的正确性。"],"recommendation":"在循环结束后添加对 depth 是否为零的检查，确保所有左括号都已闭合。","failure_explained":true,"causal_chain_complete":true,"alternative_causes":["可能存在其他条件未被检查，例如括号类型不匹配或嵌套结构错误。"],"counterexample_checked":true,"verification_steps_executed":["在循环结束后添加对 depth 是否为零的检查。","运行测试用例 '((' 来验证修改后的函数是否返回 False。","检查其他测试用例是否受影响，确保回归测试通过。"],"remaining_uncertainty":[]}
